sections.title: 1. Introduction & System Overview
sections.intro:
Analysis HMS (Hotel Management System) is a comprehensive cloud-based software designed for the Indian hospitality industry. It manages Front Office, Housekeeping, Laundry, POS, Inventory and Reporting on a unified platform — from any device, through a web browser.

The Housekeeping Module provides complete management of room cleaning, staff assignment, room status tracking and laundry services. The module is organized into four main sections: MASTER (setup), OPERATIONS (daily workflow), TRANSACTIONS/LAUNDRY (billing & settlement), REPORTS (analytics).

sections.title: 3. Master Module — Setup & Configuration
sections.intro: The Master module contains several setup entries that must be made once before operations — floors, staff, cleaning types, supervisors, checklists and amenities.

subsections.title: 3.1 Floor Master
subsections.navPath: Main Setup ▶ House Keeping ▶ Floor Master
subsections.paragraph: Define the floors of the property. Rooms and housekeepers are assigned according to each floor.

subsections.title: 3.2 Housekeeper Master
subsections.navPath: Main Setup ▶ House Keeping ▶ Housekeeper Master
subsections.paragraph: Register housekeeping staff — with their floor, supervisor and contact details.

subsections.title: 3.3 Cleaning Type Master
subsections.navPath: Main Setup ▶ House Keeping ▶ Cleaning Type
subsections.paragraph: Define the cleaning categories used at the time of room assignment.

subsections.title: 3.4 HK Supervisor Master
subsections.navPath: Main Setup ▶ House Keeping ▶ HK Supervisor
subsections.paragraph: Supervisors are registered who manage and inspect housekeepers.

subsections.title: 3.5 Checklist Master
subsections.navPath: Main Setup ▶ House Keeping ▶ Checklist
subsections.paragraph: Define the cleaning checklist items that are digitally ticked in every room cleaning.

subsections.title: 3.6 Amenities Master
subsections.navPath: Main Setup ▶ House Keeping ▶ Amenities Master
subsections.paragraph: Master list of linen, amenities and chemicals provided in the room.

rows: Pillow Cover, Bath Towel, Hand Towel

sections.title: 4. Operations Module — Daily Workflow
sections.intro: The Operations module is the core of the daily routine of housekeeping — viewing room status, assigning work, tracking cleaning, inspection and lost & found.

subsections.title: 4.1 Housekeeping Screen (Main Dashboard) — Shift+H
subsections.navPath: House Keeping ▶ Operations ▶ House Keeping Screen
subsections.paragraph: Room status grid of the entire property — cleaning status of all rooms at a glance.

subsections.title: 4.2 Room Status Board
subsections.navPath: House Keeping ▶ Operations ▶ Room Status Board
subsections.paragraph: Real-time status dashboard with summary cards — Total Rooms, Occupied Clean/Dirty, Vacant Clean/Dirty, Out of Order, Maintenance, Inspection Pending, Occupancy %. Filters: Floor, Status, Room Type, Priority.

rows: Guest present / guest present + cleaning needed

subsections.title: 4.3 Assignments (Room Assignment)
subsections.navPath: House Keeping ▶ Operations ▶ Assignments
subsections.paragraph: Interface to assign rooms to housekeepers. Left panel has unassigned rooms, right has housekeeper's bucket.

subsections.title: 4.4 Start Cleaning
subsections.navPath: House Keeping ▶ Operations ▶ Start Cleaning
subsections.paragraph: When Housekeeper starts cleaning: select assigned room → verify assignment info → Before photo upload (Camera/Gallery) → START CLEANING click. Timer T1 starts, status shows 'Cleaning In Progress'. Damage Report and Lost & Found buttons are also accessible from here.
steps: Select your room by choosing Assigned Room dropdown.
Verify Assignment No. and Room Details
Photo (Before) by capturing — from Camera or Gallery
Click the START CLEANING button (start time is recorded)

subsections.title: 4.5 Room Cleaning Entry
subsections.navPath: House Keeping ▶ Operations ▶ Room Cleaning Entry
subsections.paragraph: After cleaning is complete: select the room → tick checklist items → enter the actual end time → upload the After photo → update room status to 'Vacant Clean' / 'Occupied Clean' → Submit.
steps: Please update room status and submit.

subsections.title: 4.6 Inspection
subsections.navPath: House Keeping ▶ Operations ▶ Inspection
subsections.paragraph: Supervisor inspects the cleaned rooms: checklist review → before/after photos verify → remarks add → Approve (room clean mark) or Reject (send to re-cleaning).

rows: Select the room from the inspection list

subsections.title: 4.7 Lost & Found
subsections.navPath: House Keeping ▶ Operations ▶ Lost & Found
subsections.paragraph: Record of items found in rooms: Date Found, Room Number, Item Description, Found By, Custody, Status (Pending/Claimed/Returned), Remarks.

rows: When did you get the item?
Which room it was found in

subsections.title: 4.8 Damage Entry
subsections.navPath: House Keeping ▶ Operations ▶ Damage Entry
subsections.paragraph: Please report if you find any damage in the room — along with item description. This has been aggregated in the Damage Report.

sections.title: 5. Transactions Module — Laundry
sections.intro: Laundry module handles billing and settlement of guest laundry services. Operates through Laundry outlet (LAUN).

subsections.title: 5.1 Laundry Memo
subsections.navPath: House Keeping ▶ LAUNDRY ▶ Laundry Memo
subsections.paragraph: Creating the guest laundry bill/memo: search by Room No/Guest/Barcode → add items from the item group (Iron/Washing/Favourite) → set qty/rate → charges summary (Discount, CGST, SGST, Round Off, Net) → Bill Print or Settlement.

rows: Room No., Guest Name, Bar Code
Discount, CGST, SGST, Round Off, Net

subsections.title: 5.2 Memo Bill Reprint
subsections.navPath: House Keeping ▶ LAUNDRY ▶ Memo Bill Reprint
subsections.paragraph: To print old laundry bills again: Select For Year → Bill No. Enter → Search → load details → Bill Print.
steps: House Keeping → LAUNDRY → open Memo Bill Reprint
Search by clicking — item-wise details will load.

subsections.title: 5.3 Settlement Entry
subsections.navPath: House Keeping ▶ LAUNDRY ▶ Settlement Entry
subsections.paragraph: Record payment of pending laundry bills: enter For Year + Bill No. → select payment mode (Cash/Cheque/UPI/Card) → Amount + Narration → Submit. Total/Paid/Balance is visible in Pending Bill Details.

rows: Cash in Hand / Cheque / UPI / Card

subsections.title: 5.4 Split Bill
subsections.navPath: House Keeping ▶ LAUNDRY ▶ Split Bill
subsections.caption: Split Bill — demo property pe permission restricted (live screen)
subsections.paragraph:
Splitting one laundry bill across multiple accounts: select the original bill → define the split amounts → generate individual bills → settle each split. The splits stay linked to the original memo.

Note: This screen is restricted on the demo property — it is fully functional on a live property.
bullets: Split amounts by defining per account
Every split has a different settlement.

sections.title: 6. Linen Management
sections.intro: The Linen module tracks the external laundry movement of hotel linen — sending and receiving back, with counts.

subsections.title: 6.1 Laundry Send
subsections.navPath: House Keeping ▶ Linen Management ▶ Laundry Send
subsections.paragraph: Record of sending linen to external laundry: item, quantity, date, sent-by details. With vendor laundry challan.

subsections.title: 6.2 Laundry Receive
subsections.navPath: House Keeping ▶ Linen Management ▶ Laundry Receive
subsections.paragraph: Record of return of linen from laundry — sent quantity against received qty and pending balance is tracked.

rows: How far back have you come?
